in_marathi.name: Dharanipal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Holder of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharanipal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'dharana' meaning 'to hold' and 'pal' meaning 'earth'. Dharanipal is the name of a divine being believed to hold the earth in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Dharanipal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Holder of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dharanipal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'dharana' meaning 'to hold' and 'pal' meaning 'earth'. Dharanipal is the name of a divine being believed to hold the earth in Hindu mythology.
